llm_response.reason: The site advertises high-end Salomon shoes at prices substantially lower than normal market rates, along with claims of free shipping and easy returns to induce psychological urgency and trust. There is no verifiable company information, no contact details appropriate for business (only generic contact forms), and the domain was recently registered with complete WHOIS privacy protection. Additionally, the website closely mimics the branding of legitimate Salomon retailers, which is a noted scam tactic, all suggesting high risk of fraud.
